name: Sanguine Sorcery
summary: A librarian seeks magical works for the Library in Ironforge. Your contribution adds to its collection and knowledge.

sections.title: A Growing Collection
sections.body: In the Library of Ironforge, a librarian asks you to bring something for the collection. Your contribution helps expand the library's knowledge.

faq.answer: The librarian asks you to bring something to add to the collection.
The request comes from the Library in Ironforge.

faq.q: Why bring magical works to the library?
faq.answer: The librarian says magical works may benefit the library and expand its knowledge.
